title: A Stormy Occurrence
summary: A meteorologist is bludgeoned to death while tracking details ahead of a hurricane.
method: The killer pretended to go to their site but actually went to kill the victim. The plot was discovered when the picture showed as proof showed a longer shadow, indicating it was taken earlier in the day.
motive: The killer wanted to cover up how they plagiarized the victim's manuscript.
notes:
Gavin from Gavin and Stacey is the victim. 
Camille and DI Poole spend time together while avoiding the hurricane outside.
